name: Hiking Trails
description: Hiking trail routes and mountain shelter locations

waymarked-trails.purpose: Hiking trail search, details, and tile overlay
waymarked-trails.dataSent: Search query text or bounding box coordinates, result limit
waymarked-trails.dataReceived: Trail results with name, symbol, operator, length; tile overlay PNG; trail geometry with SAC difficulty

refuges-info.purpose: Mountain shelters, refuges, water points, and cabins
refuges-info.dataSent: Bounding box coordinates, optional shelter type filter
refuges-info.dataReceived: GeoJSON features with refuge name, type, altitude, bed capacity, coordinates

osm.purpose: Full hiking trail geometry with per-segment SAC difficulty grading
osm.dataSent: OSM relation ID for trail geometry
osm.dataReceived: Relation members with inline geometry, way tags (sac_scale, surface, highway)
